Resolves #19206

neo's shared PR baseline is now called at `v0.1.19`, the release where a bot's PR is reported, not judged, for its close target (neomjs/neo-agent-skills#118). Dependabot's #19199 fails `PR body` even after a rebase, because its run used `reusable-pr-baseline.yml@refs/tags/v0.1.17` (run 36122657042). Once this merges and #19199 is rebased, the failure goes.
- **The change:** `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml:68` moves from `@v0.1.17` to `@v0.1.19`.
- **Why nothing else changes:** between the two tags the called workflow adds no input or permission. Its new tag check (0.1.18) requires exactly `@v0.1.19`, since the workflow ref must end in `@refs/tags/v0.1.19`.
- **Why by hand:** the operator is merging neo's dependabot PRs now, and dependabot's github-actions move lags a day or more. The Institution and devindex callers stay with dependabot, so neomjs/neo-agent-skills#114's AC-4 keeps its live test.

Evidence: L3 (this PR's own `PR baseline` run is the first neo run at `v0.1.19`, `PR body` included) → L3 required (AC-1). Residual: AC-2, the rebased #19199, is post-merge. Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-skills#114.

Micro-review eligible: version-pin bump. One `uses:` tag, no behaviour of neo's own.

|---|---|

| AC-2 | Post-merge: #19199, rebased, passes `PR body` (see Post-Merge Validation). |
